description: This file contains unit tests for the NodeManagerPaths component in the OpenClaw project, specifically testing the behavior of node version path resolution and filtering logic.

classes.name: NodeManagerPathsTests
classes.description: A test suite containing functions that verify the correct ordering and filtering of Node.js version binaries managed by FNM within the OpenClaw project.

methods.name: fnm node bins prefer newest installed version
methods.description: Tests that the node manager correctly identifies the newest installed Node.js version and prioritizes its path.

methods.name: ignores entries without node executable
methods.description: Tests that directory entries missing the node executable are ignored by the path resolution logic.
